anomalies.description: A man in a dark suit is visibly holding and aiming a handgun at another person (in red coat) who is restrained or leaning over a pipe; the gun is pointed directly at the target's upper body, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting.

A man in a black suit is seen holding a handgun and aiming it at another person (in red jacket) who is positioned near a pipe; the gun is visibly pointed and held steady across multiple frames, indicating an active shooting threat or imminent discharge.

Two men in dark suits engage in close-quarters physical struggle; one appears to be disarming or grappling the other near a pipe structure.; Multiple individuals engage in close physical struggle: one person is grabbed and pushed against machinery; arms are raised in defensive/offensive postures; motion blur suggests rapid grappling and shoving in confined space.
Continuation of physical struggle involving multiple individuals in a confined space; motion blur suggests rapid movement and grappling.
A man in a suit is seen aiming and firing a handgun at close range; muzzle flash or recoil is implied by posture and hand position, though no explicit flash is visible due to low light.

Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat: one man (in dark suit) is grabbed and pulled by another (in red jacket) through a doorway, with visible struggle and facial expressions of exertion and distress.; Two individuals engage in physical combat: one in a dark suit is struck and recoils, while another in a white shirt attacks; a third person is visible in the background also involved in the fight.
A group fight erupts in a dimly lit room; multiple individuals are seen in dynamic combat stances, with one person being struck or thrown, and others actively engaging in hand-to-hand combat.
Multiple individuals in dark suits are shown aiming and firing handguns in a dimly lit tunnel; muzzle flashes and weapon postures are visible in frames f0–f3.

Two individuals are seen struggling inside a narrow, dark tunnel or shaft, raising arms and appearing to grapple while moving upward toward a light source; motion blur suggests active physical conflict.

A violent water/liquid explosion erupts from the floor of a circular chamber, with massive spray, debris ejection, and sustained hydraulic force visible across frames f9–f15; appears to be triggered by structural breach or pressure release.
